source.notes: IMPORTANT: HTTP 200 does NOT mean success here. The server rejects a breakpoint on a comment line by returning 200 OK with an in-band errorMessage attribute on the <breakpoint> element ("Cannot create a breakpoint at this position") rather than a non-2xx status. A caller that checks only the HTTP status code will silently believe the breakpoint was set. Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values were already redacted at the source (placeholders preserved as-is).
